title: JW outreach $client config
description: Structured params for one client. Instructions live in the sibling .md files; this file holds only what connector verbs and worker logic consume. Never fabricate values — unknowns are null and documented as NEEDS-FROM-<client>.

sending.description: Cold sending config. A domain is a data object; 'warmed' is the warmup_status field, not a separate kind of thing — its value just takes time/money to reach 'ready'. The deliver step only sends from domains whose warmup_status is 'ready'.

from_addresses.description: identities on this domain to rotate

compliance.description: CAN-SPAM footer pieces. outreach-write appends these to every body; outreach-deliver gates on them. A live send is blocked until both are non-null.

postal_address.description: a real physical mailing address (CAN-SPAM requires one)

economics.description: Business-dashboard economics. avg_deal_value_usd lets the pipeline (won/SOM/TAM) be valued in dollars; null = the dashboard shows counts only (never a fabricated $).

avg_deal_value_usd.description: average value of one booked-and-closed deal (a sponsored/co-developed series)

cube.description: Dimensions `market refresh` sweeps with FREE Apollo counts to decompose TAM/SAM. All optional; seniorities are always swept from targeting.

market_crosscheck.description: Independent denominator (US Census CBP) to bracket Apollo's inflated count. Needs a free CENSUS_API_KEY at run time. The NAICS set is the client's approximation of the ICP — refine it.

naics.description: NAICS codes approximating the ICP, e.g. ["311","312"]

env_profile.description: which secret bundle (SMTP/IMAP/API keys) deployment loads for this client
